outcome: degree of ossification (bones of feet and hands)
cohort: Eighteen adult female Wistar-Albino rats were divided into six groups to study the effects of nicotine and melatonin during gestation.
finding: Nicotine use during pregnancy significantly delays skeletal ossification in rat fetuses, and melatonin effectively mitigates these teratogenic effects.
gest_age: Fetuses were delivered and analyzed on gestation day 20.
